key_findings: NTG chronic migraine model raises miR-155-5p and lowers SIRT1 in the TNC; miR-155-5p inhibition restores SIRT1, reduces CGRP, c-Fos, microglial activation and TNF-alpha.
SIRT1 activation (SRT1720) alleviates, and inhibition (EX527) worsens, hyperalgesia and central sensitization.
